source: Ticket 820 (PK1, spec #647): the five planet kits of the GD's final lock (24 Oct ~15:30), from the Horizontal Scaler's handoff planet-kits-p1-p5.md. One merchant variant per planet on the #175 dock shops, differing in stock and buy list only, and one signature item per planet that turns the planet's #651 hazard (or, on P1, the return leg) into a choice. Names, hover lines and the premium tag are Progression's copy per #680, verbatim; the hover lines are two sentences by that lock, so they are held to the #680 word budget and not to the one-sentence flavour rule. Effect and trade-off are the lock's words as data; their magnitudes are PK4's (#823) to set against the ±5% felt-speed check. Planet ids are (s,p) as #790 keys them; prices key on g (planet-kit.economy.json). Ticket 824 (PK5) adds the rows the #777 generator draws a planet past the first system from, keyed by the roster's family or hazard id (TD final on Q1 with the HS conditions 1-5 and VS rows 1-7; GD Q2 = (b); Q3 per Progression and Systems): each merchant's variant noun (its name less any place name), one kit row per family or hazard id the roster can emit ({familyId, merchantVariant, premiumRule, itemId}, itemId null where the family has no authored item: premium only), the premium rule (one species of the planet's own common or mid kinds lying in a band up to reachBand, else the shallowest kind) and the row a planet with no new family draws (variant by seed). The SS1 hazards carry their PK1 items; the SS2-B families carry none until Progression authors one. Variants for the SS2-B families are by theme: vent flares at the Boilerhouse, cinder salts at the Assay, brine leeches at the Gasworks, ferro-sand sinks at the Scree Yard, spall glass at the Lapidary.

items.name: Cache Crate
items.hoverLine: Drop your hold as a crate. Sold only on Hearthmoor.

effect.summary: Drops the hold's contents as a marked crate in the shaft, to be lifted later by the owner's car only.

tradeOff.summary: The ore waits in the shaft until its owner comes back for the crate.

items.name: Scree Plough
items.hoverLine: Shoves fallen scree aside. The engine pulls weaker.

effect.summary: Rubble that refills a cut is pushed through at a crawl instead of being drilled again; the crush is unchanged.

tradeOff.summary: Engine thrust is lower while the plough is fitted.

items.name: Damp Flask
items.hoverLine: Hold still in firedamp to bottle it. Sold only on Coalfen.

effect.summary: Holding still through a breached pocket's capture window bottles the gas for sale; the drain still applies at a reduced share, never zero.

tradeOff.summary: The car stands in the gas for the capture window, and a flask is spent.

items.name: Shard Tongs
items.hoverLine: Lifts spinecrystal whole as fragile cargo. Cuts slower.

effect.summary: A spinecrystal cell comes out whole with no hull bite and fills a hold slot as fragile cargo that breaks on a hard landing.

tradeOff.summary: The cut takes longer with the tongs; ground hardness is unchanged.

items.name: Vent Vane
items.hoverLine: Ride a vent's blast up the shaft. Slower sideways.

effect.summary: Deployed over a vent, its shove carries the car further up the shaft; the scald still applies.

tradeOff.summary: Horizontal speed is lower while the vane is fitted.
